title: Monster
description: Technology-neutral definition of a monster in GUMFALL. Monsters follow anatomy-driven design (Core Pillar 7) and share damage, body-integrity, and loot rules with players. Loot is source-grounded (Core Pillar 8).

id.description: Unique identifier for this monster definition. Use kebab-case.

composition.description: Physical composition type, aligned with VERIFIED composition list.

flavor.description: Flavor affinity, aligned with VERIFIED flavor affinities.

roles.description: VERIFIED combat roles this monster fulfills.

rank.description: VERIFIED monster rank. Rank affects enchantment roll multipliers and XP.

intelligence.description: VERIFIED intelligence tier. Determines AI behavioral capability.

temperament.description: Default behavioral stance when not in combat.

level_band.description: Level range this monster appears in. Must align with VERIFIED level band descriptions.

anatomy_regions.description: Per-region body integrity data for this monster. Each region can be targeted independently and carries its own structural values. Supports Core Pillar 7 (anatomy-driven encounters).

local_structure.description: Maximum structural integrity for this region.

elasticity.description: Resistance to deformation (0.0 = no resistance, 1.0 = fully rigid).

temperature.description: Base temperature value. Affects heat/cold interactions.

stickiness.description: Stickiness factor. Affects embedded object interactions and adhesion.

crystallization.description: Starting crystallization level. Higher = more brittle.

connection_strength.description: Force required to separate this region from adjacent regions (e.g., limb detachment threshold).

armor_coverage.description: Natural armor coverage fraction for this region.

vulnerable_to.description: Damage types that deal bonus effect to this region.

resistant_to.description: Damage types that deal reduced effect to this region.

loot_sources.description: References to LootSource definitions associated with this monster. Supports Core Pillar 8 (source-grounded loot).

items.description: LootSource id referencing a loot_source.schema.json document.

ai_profile.description: High-level AI behavioral profile. Technology-neutral — describes design intent, not implementation.

behavior_archetype.description: Top-level behavioral pattern this monster follows.

escape_threshold.description: Fraction of core vitality remaining at which this monster attempts to flee or call reinforcements.

notes.description: Design notes on intended encounter feel.

description.description: Plain-text design description of this monster's ecology, appearance, and combat style.

notes.description: Internal design notes, authority labels, or open questions.
